result.reasoning: This commit introduced the `getPageNumberFor` method with `int pageNum = 0;` as the initial value. The fix changes this initialization to `-1` so that a title page (index 0, position 0) correctly resolves to page number 0 instead of being ambiguous with pageNum starting at 0. The line was never modified afterward by other commits in the blame history except by adjacent null-check additions, so this is the commit that introduced the buggy initialization.
